scoring.wrongClose: Conversation closed where expected=open, or pending work cancelled without authorization; high severity.
scoring.missedClose: Conversation remains active after an unambiguous closing reply and any authorized work finishes; medium severity.
scoring.safeAbstention: Unclear/corrupted text stays open; a clarification is permitted, not a successful intended close.
scoring.adoption: Adopt contextual only with zero extra wrong closes and at least one fewer missed close, or fewer wrong closes with no more missed closes. No lost source/work. Otherwise keep current. Repeats reported separately.
scoring.scope: Same conversation text and threshold; explicit closing-offer metadata differs. Generation, tools, speech and enrichment are fixtures. This measures reply routing, not how often a real model asks an appropriate closing question.
